description: Main entry for news. Give a topic or question in any language; get matching live radar headlines with link, outlet and a passport. Each passport line names the sensor and the scientist cards that produced it (speech act, checkability, state media, retellings vs first source, chain or wave, loudness vs measurement for earthquakes, warning signs for science headlines, call-to-action words, loaded words, number checkable). It lists signs and reasons with the quoted words, never a verdict of true or false; null means not measured. Also returns data_gaps (what Orb Studio has switched off now) and topic_sensors (rates, crypto, quakes, science). No AI, free, not a forecast.

topic.description: Topic or question, e.g. Hormuz, Ukraine, Europe, Bundestag; empty = top headlines

name: get_news_by_topic
title: News on a topic with a passport: radar headlines about Hormuz, Ukraine, Europe, politics … each with signs and reasons from the sensors and scientist cards behind them
